newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-TOWNSEND TO CAPTAIN SCOTLAND AGAINST AUSTRALIA.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TOWNSEND TO CAPTAIN SCOTLAND AGAINST AUSTRALIA.

text.p: Gregor Townsend was on Friday named Scotland captain for the rugby union test against Australia at Murrayfield on November 9.

Townsend deputises for the injured Rob Wainwright and is the only player certain of his place against the Wallabies after the Scottish selectors took the unusual step of naming a squad rather than a team.
"The decision to announce a squad of 21 has become inevitable in the professional era," team manager Arthur Hastie said.
"In future we may delay the announcement until the actual day of the game. I don't see it as a bad thing."
The Scottish selectors have named both Townsend and Craig Chalmers as potential fly-halves but it is likely Townsend will play at centre, with Chalmers in the number 10 jersey.
Among the forwards loose-head prop Tom Smith has been promoted from the Scotland A team which lost 47-20 to the Wallabies on Wednesday.
Backs: Gary Armstrong, Craig Chalmers, Ronnie Eriksson, Scott Hastings, Kenny Logan, Bryan Redpath, Rowen Shepherd, Tony Stanger, Derek Stark, Gregor Townsend.
Forwards: Damian Cronin, Graham Ellis, David Hilton, Kevin McKenzie, Scott Murray, Eric Peters, Ian Smith, Tom Smith, Barry Stewart, Murray Wallace, Doddie Weir.
